[[Incetol's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Incetol, Devout of Depths]], a [[boss]] in [[Rhea's Crater]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Healing Prayers]])
:Halves casting time of [[Healing Prayers]] spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Divine Symbol (loop)]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated as it effectively requires two perfect [[focus core]]s, ''of Fortitude'' and ''of Aptitude''.
